data.description:
## Observation
On 2026-11-19 at about 20:57 PST (load average 42.97/43.57/41.22 on the shared agent host), a targeted pytest run in worktree fix-test-git-maint-detach (73 tests, -n 4) reported 72 passed and 1 error: tests/unit/test_topology_template_upkeep_guard.py::test_a_partially_pinned_repository_is_still_refused errored in teardown with subprocess.TimeoutExpired from tests/_isolation.py head() (git -C <worktree> rev-parse HEAD, 5 s watchdog, re-sampled GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS times). The test body passed.

Closed bug dominating-removable-monkfish measured the same probe (p99 2.08 s, max 3.30 s under 18 processes x 100 probes) and closed with an environment-or-config disposition. This is the same symptom at a higher load than that measurement covered.

## Hypotheses (unproven)
- Process-spawn and scheduler saturation at load ~43 pushes all re-sampled probes past 5 s.
- Contention on the shared checkout's object store or index from concurrent agent sessions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Probe latency is measured at a load comparable to 40+ and the outcome is recorded here.
- [ ] Either the guard tolerates that load without a false teardown error (with a regression test), or the ticket records why the current bound is kept.
data.title: Repo-isolation HEAD watchdog still errors a passing test at host load ~43
